1.0.1.en: Added Zigbee Dongle E/P, SNZB-04P, ZBMINI, and SNZB-02LD/WD drivers, plus settings fixes for ZBMINIR2/MINI-ZBD.

1.0.5.en: Availability tracking for mains-powered devices (ZBMINI, ZBMINIR2, MINI-ZB1GP/GSP, SNZB-06P, Zigbee Dongle E/P) and for the battery sensors (SNZB-02LD/WD, SNZB-04P/PR2), using each sensor's own heartbeat, with a Traffic and Rejoins overview in the app settings. New devices: MINI-ZB2GS 2-gang switch, SNZB-05P water leak sensor and SNZB-09P siren. SNZB-04P battery reporting and SNZB-06P fixes. Re-pair the SNZB-04P/04PR2 and SNZB-02LD/WD to enable the Poll Control heartbeat.
